title: Burisch and his wife's strange vlogs

tellings.quote: when I was hanging out with with Chris Ramsey, he showed me the most bizarre videos of um Dan Barish and his wife

plain: A man named Dan Burisch and his wife made some very odd home videos. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says he saw them himself while spending time with the YouTuber Chris Ramsay, who showed them to him and called them the most bizarre videos. He says nothing more about what is in them.
